title: ControllerProcessorRole
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — controller and processor role classification under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Determines the entity's role in personal data processing and associated obligations. Controllers determine purposes and means; processors act on controller instructions. Rootless — regulatory scoping dimension. Source: GDPR Article 4(7)-(8), Articles 26-28.

role.description: The entity's role under GDPR. CONTROLLER: determines purposes and means of processing (Art 4(7)). JOINT_CONTROLLER: jointly determines purposes and means with one or more controllers (Art 26). PROCESSOR: processes personal data on behalf of the controller (Art 4(8), Art 28). SUB_PROCESSOR: engaged by a processor to carry out specific processing activities (Art 28(2)-(4)).

establishedInEU.description: Whether the entity has an establishment in the EU. Determines territorial scope under Art 3(1).

representativeDesignated.description: Whether a representative in the EU has been designated. Required for non-EU controllers/processors processing EU data subjects' data under Art 3(2). Source: GDPR Art 27.

processingAgreementInPlace.description: Whether a data processing agreement (DPA) is in place between controller and processor. Must set out subject-matter, duration, nature, purpose, type of personal data, categories of data subjects, and controller obligations/rights. Source: GDPR Art 28(3).

jointControllerArrangement.description: Whether a transparent arrangement between joint controllers determines respective responsibilities. Required when role is JOINT_CONTROLLER. Source: GDPR Art 26(1).
